exit_policy.label: Legacy: exit at close of day 5

notes: positions: every row of journal/my_positions.csv with its FROZEN initial stop, the default exit policy's trailing level (peak ratchets up only) and effective stop = max(initial, trail); `policies` repeats that for every tracked exit policy (fixed_5d / trail_2atr / trail_1pct), but only the default policy drives action, streaks and auto-close. pending_exits: positions flagged SELL_STOP/SELL_TRAIL/SELL_TIME or TAKE_PROFIT_2R/3R for 3+ consecutive ASX trading days with no action. Exit flags auto-close at 10 consecutive trading days (recent_auto_closes); profit-take flags are never auto-closed.
